_comment: Mutation testing. Quantifies how well the suite actually catches bugs by injecting mutants into the highest-risk core logic (the erasure rewrite, generation numbering and GC, bounded concurrency, bit routing, the due index) and checking the suite kills them. Offline + slow (a mutant runs the covering tests) — NOT a CI gate — run via `pnpm mutation`, which fetches Stryker with `pnpm dlx` so its ~80 packages stay out of the root lockfile; `break` is null so it never fails a build, it just reports a score.
